：军令如山（：军令如山（第22页）陆川丝毫没有慌乱，手脚轻动，立刻爬到树上。“凭什么又是老子守夜？隔两天就要轮一次，觉都睡不好。银子没我的份，女人也轮不到我。前几日掳来的那个娘们，倒是让大当家好好爽了一把。”这名匪徒走到大树底下，解开腰带。他一边嘟囔着，一边对着树根放水。陆川没有贸然动手，依旧静静潜伏在树上。就在这时，西侧骤然响起兵刃相撞的脆响。“杀！”嘈杂的声音炸响。树下的匪徒猛地抬头，浑身一颤，失声惊呼：“有官兵打上门了！”转瞬之间，整座山寨乱作一团。无数匪徒从睡梦当中惊醒，一间间木屋房门接连被推开。陆川快速扫视两侧。他心知，显然是另外两个千户所的先锋队伍，暴露在了匪寇哨岗面前。就在树下匪徒转身准备返回篝火旁时，陆川当机立断，从树上纵身跃下。不等匪徒抬头看清人影，张嘴呼救，陆川已经将他死死按倒在地，一拳击碎了他的喉咙。他不打算继续停留，准备立刻下山撤退。就在这时，‘砰！’离他最近的木屋，轰然打开。一名魁梧壮汉跨步走出，目光扫来，刚好与陆川四目相对。陆川心头一紧，还来不及做出反应。那大汉只是看了他一眼，随手抄起门角靠着的大刀，厉声喝道：“哪来的贼子，竟敢来我黑云山闹事！”话音未落，他大步疾驰，径直朝着陆川猛冲过来。陆川没有犹豫，立刻向后急退，想要冲下山林。为了方便潜行，他并未携带长枪，只在背上背着紫檀猎弓，另有几支箭矢用来防身。若是近身缠斗，必然会吃不小的亏。二人相距不过十余步，大汉脚步飞快，转瞬就冲到陆川身前。大汉挥起大刀朝着陆川狠狠劈下。陆川毫无惧色，一拳横击在刀身，大刀偏出轨迹，重重劈落在地面。“你这厮好大的力气！”大汉面露惊色，黝黑的胸膛骤然绷紧，横刀再起，朝着陆川劈出一记提刀斩。但陆川根本无心缠斗，脚步轻轻一侧，躲开了这一刀。紧接着他不再停留，转身朝着山下飞速奔逃。“原来是个没胆子的贼人！”大汉正要快步追赶，望见四周火光四起，立刻停下脚步，口中骂个不停。陆川很快奔到半山腰。崔锦一行人看见他折返，再望见山寨里火光冲天，人声喧哗，神色顿时紧张起来：“队长，咱们暴露了？”陆川摇了摇头。“立刻撤到山脚，去找总旗梁平，禀报山寨里面的布防情况。”一行人纷纷点头，快步冲下山去。片刻功夫，众人便回到河西军队的阵前。总旗梁平盯着陆川，厉声开口：“陆小旗，你是怎么办事的？为何打草惊蛇？”陆川上前拱手禀报：“梁总旗，是另外两支队伍先行暴露行踪。”可梁平根本不愿听他辩解，厉声喝道：“无论缘由如何，你的探查任务已然失败。现在，我命你部充当先锋，带领大部队向前强攻。”

Chapter 43 Military orders are like mountains (page 1)
: Military orders are like mountains (: Military orders are like mountains (page 22)) Lu Chuan did not panic at all, and immediately climbed up the tree with his hands and feet. "Why is it that I am keeping watch again? I have to take turns every two days, and I can't sleep well. I don't have money, and women can't take my turn. The girl kidnapped a few days ago really made the boss feel good." The gangster walked to the bottom of the big tree and untied his belt. He muttered and said to Lu Chuan did not take action rashly, but still lurked quietly in the tree. At this moment, there was a sudden sound of weapons clashing on the west side, and the gangster under the tree suddenly raised his head. , trembled all over, and exclaimed: "Officers and soldiers are knocking on the door!" In an instant, the whole village was in chaos. Countless gangsters woke up from their sleep, and the doors of the wooden houses were pushed open one after another. On both sides. He knew that the other two Qianhusuo vanguard teams were obviously exposed to the bandit sentry post. Just as the bandit turned around and prepared to return to the campfire, Lu Chuan made a sudden decision and jumped down from the tree. Before the bandit could look up and open his mouth to call for help, Lu Chuan had already pinned him to the ground and smashed his throat with a punch. He did not intend to stay any longer and was about to retreat down the mountain immediately. ! ’ The wooden house closest to him suddenly opened. A burly man stepped out and met Lu Chuan’s eyes. Lu Chuan’s heart tightened, and before he could react, the big man just glanced at him, picked up the big knife leaning on the corner of the door, and yelled: "How dare you come to my Black Cloud Mountain to cause trouble!" Before he finished speaking, he sprinted towards Lu Chuan. , immediately retreated, trying to rush down the forest. In order to facilitate sneaking, he only carried a red sandalwood hunting bow on his back, and a few arrows for self-defense. If they were to fight in close quarters, they would definitely suffer a big loss. The big man moved quickly and rushed in front of Lu Chuan. Lu Chuan showed no fear and struck the blade with a cross. He slashed hard to the ground. "You have so much strength!" The big man looked shocked, his dark chest tightened suddenly, and he raised his sword again and slashed towards Lu Chuan. But Lu Chuan had no intention of fighting. He stepped lightly to avoid the knife. Then he stopped and turned around and ran away quickly down the mountain. "It turned out to be a courageous thief!" The big man was about to chase after him when he saw fire all around. Lu Chuan immediately stopped and cursed. He quickly ran to the mountainside. Cui Jin and his party saw him turning back, and saw the fire in the village and the roar of people, and their expressions suddenly became tense: "Captain, let's go." Exposed?" Lu Chuan shook his head. "Immediately retreat to the foot of the mountain, go to General Banner Liang Ping, and report the defense situation inside the stronghold." The group of people nodded and rushed down the mountain. After a while, everyone returned. In front of the Hexi Army's formation, General Flag Liang Ping stared at Lu Chuan and spoke sternly: "Lu Xiaoqi, what did you do? Why did you alert the enemy?" Lu Chuan stepped forward and reported, "General Flag Liang, it was the other two teams that exposed their whereabouts first." But Liang Ping was not willing to listen to his excuse and shouted sternly: "No matter the reason, your exploration mission has failed. Now, I order you to act as the vanguard and lead the large army to attack."
